documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has Informed To The Exchange About Update On Capacity Addition.

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported its audited financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, showing growth across consolidated revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management highlighted robust demand in adhesives supported by GST reductions and distribution reach, offset by demand softness in industrial polymers and replacement tyres. The company is advancing a demerger of its agri business into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited and plans to commence a new polymer manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat. Input cost pressures in sulphur, acid, and certain raw materials were noted alongside proactive mitigation through pricing actions. Jubilant Agri reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 MN for Q3 FY26, up 13% YoY.

guidance.claim: Raw material pricing for performance polymers is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27.

guidance.quote: Overall outlook remains positive, supported by an above-normal monsoon, improved soil moisture, and healthy reservoir levels, which are expected to strengthen sowing activity and rural sentiment in the Rabi season

demand_outlook.quote: Stable domestic construction demand, supporting growth prospects

demand_outlook.quote: Industrial and Food polymers faced demand softness due to USA tariff uncertainty but gained share in other regions

demand_outlook.claim: Urban housing demand was uplifted by rising renovations and adoption of modular furniture.
demand_outlook.quote: Urban housing demand uplifted driven by rising renovations and modular furniture adoption

demand_outlook.claim: Favourable monsoons and agricultural sentiment across key markets drove high double-digit revenue growth in Agri Products in Q2-FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Favourable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment across key markets contributed to high double-digit revenue growth in Q2-FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: Renovation activity and modular furniture adoption are driving growth in urban housing.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising renovation activity, increasing adoption of modular furniture driving growth in urban housing

capex_expansion.claim: The company will commence its state of the art Polymer manufacturing facility at Samlya in Q1 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved an investment of approximately INR 50 Crores to set up a Performance Polymers capacity expansion at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved the expansion of its Performance Polymers (WWA and SBR Latex) manufacturing capacity of the Company by setting up a manufacturing facility at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara site.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved a CAPEX of approximately Rs. 50 Crs for new manufacturing facilities at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expansion of its Performance Polymers and Chemical segment by setting up new manufacturing facilities at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Gujarat site.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex project will increase the manufacturing capacity of the Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.

margins_costs.quote: Input cost pressures emerged in March 2026; however, timely pricing actions and higher raw material inventory levels enabled the company to effectively manage short-term supply disruption while managing the margins
